protocol.title: Cross-sectional options implied-vol TERM-SLOPE basis (BTC-vs-ETH relative near-minus-far ATM IV term slope) -> subsequent relative *realized-vol* (RV) spread (BTC-minus-ETH forward RV): wrapper-free Spearman rank information coefficient (predictiveness) falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-74 (same causal term-ratio reconstruction ``term_ratio = IV(near) - IV(far)`` from the real Deribit option trade tape, reused verbatim) and EVAL-77 (same cross-sectional BTC-vs-ETH alignment and forward-RV spread target, reused verbatim) but a DISTINCT cell: the *cross-sectional term-ratio basis* (not the single-underlying term slope of EVAL-74, not the cross-sectional level/skew basis of EVAL-77) with the forward relative *realized-vol* spread (not the RV level of EVAL-74, not the relative direction of EVAL-88, not the relative VRP spread of EVAL-89/92, not the relative vol-of-vol spread of EVAL-90/91); no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the cross-sectional term-ratio partner to EVAL-74 (own-asset term slope) and EVAL-77 (cross-sectional level/skew basis); both used the same forward-RV target machinery. It makes a predictiveness claim only, no traded-form / monetization claim

cross_section.target: y_k = RV_BTC(k) - RV_ETH(k) with RV_i(k) = sqrt(mean(log-return^2)) over the next H perp bars strictly after k (relative realized-vol spread)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar implied-vol term structure from the real Deribit option trade tape (EVAL-74 ``_term_bars``): near-ATM trades grouped by expiry; term_ratio = IV(near expiry) - IV(far expiry) in vol points; near = earliest and far = latest expiry each with >= min_expiry_trades near-ATM trades in the trailing window. The term_ratio field is overlaid by bar_open_ms onto EVAL-77's common aligned cross-section; the relative series (ETH - BTC) is forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e77._relative_signal_series / e61.expanding_zscore).
protocol.target_detail: forward relative realized-vol spread: per underlying RV = sqrt(mean(log-return^2)) over the next H perp bars (strictly after the decision at bar k, EVAL-77 ``_rv_series`` verbatim), then BTC minus ETH on the common aligned bar grid
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(rel_z_k, y_k) over the common aligned bar-ends (H1: IC > 0, ETH term-ratio-richness predicts BTC subsequently carries a richer forward RV — relative-value RV mean reversion)

stats.permutation: directional (H1: IC>0), shuffle the relative-RV spread

protocol.go_bar: GO only if at least one config (term_ratio basis x bar grid x horizon) has Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, at least min_usable_pairs_per_config usable pairs, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
